This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Biology and appearance==
This humanoid [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin and lump-covered cranium.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> at least one other member of the species visited [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm|fourth episode]] of the [[2021]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', directed by [[Kevin Tancharoen]].<ref name="Chapter 4" />
